Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

State whether the predeclared path-quality threshold and each guardrail passed, the rollout the result supports, the boundaries that remain unchanged, and the commercial conclusions the result does not establish.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Q4 Pricing Path Clarity Test — Outcome Memo", "folder": "growth-evidence", "body": "Q4 Pricing Path Clarity Test — Outcome Memo
Date: January 1, 2028

Decision-safe outcome
The certified four-cohort organic pricing-page test passed the predeclared path-quality threshold and both guardrails. It supports the path-separated treatment as the default experience for organic pricing-page traffic. That rollout was authorized by Priya on November 25, 2025 and implemented by Daniela at 100% of organic traffic on November 26, 2025; the control was retired.

Certified result
- Population: 3,286 organic pricing-page sessions — 1,639 control and 1,647 treatment.
- Path-quality threshold: PASSED. Existing unsupported-condition route-outs fell from 38/344 control (11.0%) to 25/352 treatment (7.1%), a 35.7% relative reduction, exceeding the predeclared threshold of at least 25%.
- Guardrail 1, eligible-workspace admission completion: PASSED. 43.8% control versus 44.1% treatment, a 0.3-percentage-point increase; the limit was no more than a 1.5-point decline.
- Guardrail 2, account-level support time at p90: PASSED. 71 minutes control versus 74 minutes treatment, a 3-minute increase; the limit was no more than a 10-minute increase.
- The favorable direction held across all three weekly cohorts and the November 10–16 stabilization cohort. No unrelated pricing-page layout or UI change occurred during the test, supporting the attribution check for this path-quality result.

Rollout supported
Adopt and retain separate entry paths for the bounded under-50, simple-deployment Helio Start path and assisted needs on organic pricing-page traffic. The result supports fewer unsupported self-serve starts and a pricing-page path-quality rollout decision.

Boundaries that remain unchanged
- Helio Start eligibility, refusal, connector-access, and external-authority rules.
- Lifecycle, instrumentation, admission, and Customer Success support-routing rules.
- The existing assisted path and its operating boundaries.
- Paid-acquisition scope and all acquisition-admission rules.
- No paid traffic was tested; no pipeline target or forecast credit is created.

Commercial conclusions not established
This result does not establish revenue lift, revenue attribution, pricing or conversion economics, paid-acquisition performance or scalability, pipeline impact, forecast credit, payback, customer lifetime value, or a basis for increasing acquisition spend. It also does not change Helio Start eligibility, prove that the result generalizes beyond the observed organic pricing-page population or window, or establish that treatment caused downstream commercial outcomes beyond the measured path-quality improvement."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_008_01", "path": "args", "criterion": "The memo states that the stabilized test result cleared the predeclared path-quality threshold and both guardrails and supports adopting the treatment for organic pricing-page traffic, framing the measured benefit as fewer unsupported self-serve starts or improved path quality rather than commercial performance.

The memo clearly states that admission and acquisition boundaries remain unchanged and does not imply that the experiment broadened admission rules or acquisition access.

Date: January 1, 2028

Decision-safe outcome
The certified four-cohort organic pricing-page test passed the predeclared path-quality threshold and both guardrails. It supports the path-separated treatment as the default experience for organic pricing-page traffic. That rollout was authorized by Priya on November 25, 2025 and implemented by Daniela at 100% of organic traffic on November 26, 2025; the control was retired.

Certified result
- Population: 3,286 organic pricing-page sessions — 1,639 control and 1,647 treatment.
- Path-quality threshold: PASSED. Existing unsupported-condition route-outs fell from 38/344 control (11.0%) to 25/352 treatment (7.1%), a 35.7% relative reduction, exceeding the predeclared threshold of at least 25%.
- Guardrail 1, eligible-workspace admission completion: PASSED. 43.8% control versus 44.1% treatment, a 0.3-percentage-point increase; the limit was no more than a 1.5-point decline.
- Guardrail 2, account-level support time at p90: PASSED. 71 minutes control versus 74 minutes treatment, a 3-minute increase; the limit was no more than a 10-minute increase.
- The favorable direction held across all three weekly cohorts and the November 10–16 stabilization cohort. No unrelated pricing-page layout or UI change occurred during the test, supporting the attribution check for this path-quality result.

Rollout supported
Adopt and retain separate entry paths for the bounded under-50, simple-deployment Helio Start path and assisted needs on organic pricing-page traffic. The result supports fewer unsupported self-serve starts and a pricing-page path-quality rollout decision.

Boundaries that remain unchanged
- Helio Start eligibility, refusal, connector-access, and external-authority rules.
- Lifecycle, instrumentation, admission, and Customer Success support-routing rules.
- The existing assisted path and its operating boundaries.
- Paid-acquisition scope and all acquisition-admission rules.
